items.title: Birdhouse: plan a build
items.text: A new app for woodworking plans. Type what you want, like a table 1200 long and 700 wide, or pick a bookshelf, table, box or bench, and a to-scale plan appears on blueprint paper: front, side and top views, a 3D model you can drag to turn, a cut list of every board, how to lay the boards out on sheets and timber lengths, and what it will cost to buy. Your last plans are kept on this device.
